thread:
sara_devsec: heads-up — we started getting tenant decrypt errors for a handful of requests after last night's key rotation. report from support: ~50 failed decrypts, intermittent, same tenant id.
raj_oncall: seeing logs now, getting `AccessDenied` from KMS decrypt for the proxy role. CloudTrail shows decrypt attempts succeed for some request ids and 403 for others.
eli_support: customer reported higher 5xx rate and a billing spike (retries). ticket #CS-8841. they included stack traces, I'll paste minimal: 
```
ERROR: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied: encryption context mismatch for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01
RequestId: d9f4a2c0
```

sara_devsec: encryption context mismatch — classic. but logs also show some requests arriving with a proxy header `X-Redwood-KMS-ARN` that had the old key alias. suspect proxy or cache is replaying stale header during the key-swap.
nate_infra: we rotated alias last night and then a small window of traffic was served from warm proxies in other AZs. they might have cached the old alias -> new key mapping. cache TTL is 600s.
maria_compliance: FYI we need to capture CloudTrail events for affected tenants for retention/audit. make sure we don't delete any CT events for 90 days.
raj_oncall: repro steps I ran: 
1) curl to proxy with tenant header `x-tenant` and `X-Redwood-KMS-ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:alias/old-alias`
2) proxy forwards to decrypt service, service calls KMS decrypt without overriding encryption context.
3) KMS returns AccessDenied for some calls.

I can reproduce locally by forcing proxy to use cached alias mapping.
eli_support: attaching a snippet customer sent showing the HTTP proxy header set by their SDK (they use our hosted SDK): 
```
X-Redwood-KMS-ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:alias/old-alias
X-Encryption-Context: {"tenant":"acme-123"}
```

sara_devsec: actionable items: 1) add temporary guard to proxy to validate alias -> current key ARN mapping before forwarding; 2) invalidate alias-to-key cache across pool; 3) add metric/alert for increased decrypt AccessDenied counts per key.
nate_infra: rolling cache invalidation started on prod-1 and prod-2. ETA to full fleet 8m.
raj_oncall: workaround pushed: proxy now strips `X-Redwood-KMS-ARN` header if alias is older than rotation timestamp stored in config. also updated logs to include key id used for decrypt.
eli_support: relayed workaround to CS and customer accepted. they want a postmortem and root cause because this affects compliance reporting.
maria_compliance: please capture the full list of affected tenants and timestamps. we need to run an audit to ensure no PII exposure during retries/failures. also preserve audit logs and KMS CloudTrail entries.
sara_devsec: quick timeline for postmortem: who owns RCA? I can take the incident writeup. need the following from infra: list of proxies that served stale headers, arrays of request ids, and CloudTrail decrypt/response pairs.
nate_infra: I'll collect proxy hostnames and container ids. also found one edge case: HSM-backed key had grant tokens that expired during rotation, causing repeated AccessDenied on retry for requests that used grant tokens. log excerpt: 
```
kms: Decrypt grant token expired -> 403
```

raj_oncall: that explains the intermittent nature — some requests used grants (long-lived sessions) while others used regular IAM.
eli_support: notes for repro in staging: 
- set up alias swap script `alias-swap.sh`
- warm a small fleet of proxies with old mapping (simulate traffic)
- trigger swap, then send parallel decrypts with old header and correct encryption context

script for local test: 
```
# simulate proxy header replay
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -H "X-Redwood-KMS-ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:alias/old-alias" \
       -H "X-Encryption-Context: {\"tenant\":\"acme-123\"}" \
       https://proxy.local/decrypt &
done
```

sara_devsec: recommended permanent fixes: 
- reduce alias cache TTL to 30s during rotations and broadcast invalidation on alias-change events
- make proxy canonicalize alias->key mapping at read time and include key-id in forwarded header (so downstream doesn't trust raw alias)
- ensure grant token lifecycle is validated as part of rotation, rotate grants when key is swapped or create fallback grant logic
- add post-rotation smoke tests that run decrypts across all proxy AZs

maria_compliance: also need confirmation that CloudTrail and KMS audit logs for affected period are exported to our long-term S3 bucket and are immutable. legal will request chain-of-custody if customer pursues claim.
raj_oncall: opened internal ticket INFRA-1292 to track cache invalidation work, and CS-8841 remains the customer-facing ticket. adding owners.
deploybot: deploy artifact redwood/proxy:v2.14.7 promoted to prod with hotfix (strip-stale-arn) — rollout 3/3 AZs.
eli_support: post-hotfix, support saw decrypt success rate back to normal within 12m for the affected tenant. no other tenants reported issues.
sara_devsec: ok let's sync in 30m for initial RCA draft. thanks all, good containment. :thumbsup:
summary: KMS decrypt AccessDenied after alias rotation due to proxy header cache and expired grant tokens; hotfix strips stale ARN and invalidates cache; action items include TTL reduction, grant lifecycle checks, CloudTrail preservation
